title: Dow's Boat Rental

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: One of the most important aspects of a fishing lure is how it moves in the water. Multi-jointed lures create a natural swimming motion that mimics real fish. Glide baits move slowly from side to side, making them perfect for attracting cautious predators. Vibration lures produce strong underwater pulses that fish can feel, even in murky water. This makes them highly effective when visibility is low. Understanding lure action helps you choose the right tool for the situation and significantly improves your catch

gap: Prices for boat rentals not stated
blurb: Dow's Boat Rental provides boat rentals and professional maintenance services on Lake Hopatcong. They maintain high-quality, well-serviced boats and offer fast, dependable repair services. They support both beginners and experienced boaters to ensure a safe and enjoyable boating experience.
